title: Welcome to my blog
excerpt: What this blog is and how it is built.
body:
This blog is a **Groundfloor Shell app**. Posts live in the `blog_posts` Data Vault collection.

## What you can do

- Read published posts
- Write drafts in Markdown
- Publish when ready

> Drafts are only visible to people who can read the collection.
